title: Semidirect-product / index-2 structure assumes dihedral reduced group; A4,S4,A5 missing (Thm 3.3(e))

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body: Thm 3.3(e) writes $\bar G=\langle\bar G^\circ,\sigma\rangle$ with $\sigma$ an involution and uses $R=(R^\circ)^{\langle\sigma\rangle}$ with Noether's 2-element symmetrization (adjoin $f+\sigma f$, $f\cdot\sigma f$). This presupposes $\bar G$ is cyclic or dihedral. But the problem explicitly says the dihedral-type invariants are 'associated with the normalizer of $\langle\tau\rangle$', and the reduced automorphism group of a cyclic curve can be $A_4,S_4,A_5$ (finite subgroups of $\mathrm{PGL}_2$). For these, $R$ is not an index-2 extension of a cyclic-invariant ring, the symmetrization argument fails, and the whole (e)$\Rightarrow$algorithm pipeline for the non-cyclic part is invalid. The classification of possible $\bar G$ is not even stated, so these cases are entirely missing.
